caption: The drawing is composed of several black-ink illustrations on a beige or off-white background. On the left, there is a detailed front view of a tall grandfather clock showing distinct features such as a rectangular base, a central door with a knob and a keyhole, and a rounded top section housing the clock face. The clock face displays Roman numerals from I to XII, two clock hands, and visible internal gears. Adjacent to this, on the right, is a profile view of the same clock, highlighting its depth, decorative top, and side detailing. In the center, there are two large, detailed depictions of clock hands, one shorter and broader with geometric and ornate elements, and the other longer and slender with a pointed tip. Below these, there is an intricately designed keyhole escutcheon featuring symmetrical scrollwork and a central oval plate. The composition is technical and schematic, with each element carefully outlined, and the overall color scheme is monochrome black on a light background, with no shading or color infill.
title: Clock
